ai_red_flags: Recent layoffs of ~1,600 including 900+ software R&D roles; GAAP unprofitable; no verified QA openings.
ai_summary: Atlassian builds Jira, Confluence and other team collaboration software, remote-first and open to Maine. But its domain is SaaS dev tooling, not regulated medical devices or hardware test equipment, and no QA openings were verified.
maine_remote: yes: Team Anywhere: employees choose where, when and how they work; 11 offices they can work from; teams gather in person 3-4 times per year.
next_research_action: No supported job board - check https://www.atlassian.com/company/careers manually
outreach_notes: Fifteen years of C#/.NET test automation and tooling at scale could support Atlassian's engineering quality as it restructures around AI, though your FDA-regulated V&V depth is a domain shift.

Job board and ATS unknown; no QA openings found.
